name: globalblocs-quant-mobile
description: GlobalBLOCS Quant phone app (Android + iPhone) built with Capacitor from the shared dashboard

scripts.android:init: npm run web && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && node scripts/configure-native.js android && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:init && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:init: npm run web && (test -d ios || npx cap add ios) && node scripts/configure-native.js ios && npx cap sync ios
